copy.assign.noLauncher.text: its check copy's job takes no launcher now
copy.assign.noLauncher.note: Why cw-progress's launcher wasn't put in its check copy's job: it has one already, or no job.

copy.assign.noLease.note: Why cw-progress's launcher wasn't put in its check copy's job: the lease it named isn't this agent's.

copy.assign.notOwn.text: that process isn't one of this agent's own
copy.assign.notOwn.note: Why cw-progress's launcher wasn't put in its check copy's job: the process isn't the agent's (HR1's #1435 round 1).

copy.assign.notPut.text: the check's launcher couldn't be put in its check copy's job
copy.assign.notPut.note: Why cw-progress's launcher wasn't put in its check copy's job: Windows refused it.

copy.assign.returned.note: Why cw-progress's launcher wasn't put in its check copy's job: the copy was given back meanwhile.

copy.error.checkout.note: A copy's reset error: `git checkout` of the revision failed. {error} is git's first line, else failed.

copy.error.clean.note: A copy's reset error: `git clean` failed. {error} is git's first line, else failed.

copy.error.closed.note: Why a copy wasn't set up, or an isolated check's copy wasn't leased: its workspace closed.

copy.error.interrupted.note: A check or review copy's error, kept on the copy, when its reset was taken over from a Combwork that is gone (#1435).

copy.error.notListed.text: its folder is there but git does not list it as a worktree
copy.error.notListed.note: A copy's error: its folder exists but isn't a worktree git knows, so Combwork leaves it alone.

copy.error.setupExit.note: A copy's setup error: its setup command failed. {code} is its exit code.

copy.error.setupNoStart.note: A copy's setup error: its setup command couldn't be started. {command} is the command.

copy.error.setupNotEnded.text: processes its setup started could not be ended
copy.error.setupNotEnded.note: A copy's setup error: its setup command ended, but processes it started are still running.

copy.error.setupTimedOut.text: its setup ran out of time
copy.error.setupTimedOut.note: A copy's setup error: its setup command reached its time limit.

copy.error.worktreeAdd.note: A copy's setup error: `git worktree add` failed. {error} is git's first line, else failed.

copy.held.job.note: What holds a returned copy back from being freed: processes of the run that had it. {job} is their job's id. The end of copy.refusal.stillInUse and of "held back by …".

copy.held.process.text: a process with a file or folder open in it
copy.held.process.note: What holds a copy back from being freed or removed: a process has something open in its folder.

copy.inUse.all.text: the pool's {size} {count, plural, =1 {copy is} other {copies are}} in use
copy.inUse.all.note: Why a reviewer waits for a review copy (HI-1764): every copy is in use. {size} is the pool's size as digits; {count} the same number, choosing the plural.

copy.inUse.longest.note: copy.inUse.all, then the copy lent longest: {time} is copy.inUse.minutes, {kind} the lease's kind (review or check), {card} the card's key.

copy.inUse.minutes.note: How long, in whole minutes: in copy.inUse.returned and copy.inUse.longest.

copy.inUse.returned.text: {all}; {copy}, returned {ago} ago, is {held, select, yes {held back by {by}} other {being freed}}
copy.inUse.returned.note: copy.inUse.all, then the copy likely to come free first: one given back, and what still holds it ({by}: copy.held.*, a run or an agent), else being freed. {ago} is copy.inUse.minutes.

copy.isolated.noLease.text: no check copy could be leased
copy.isolated.noLease.note: cw-progress --isolated's refusal: no check copy could be lent, for another reason.

copy.isolated.noSupervisor.text: Combwork's process supervisor isn't running, so an isolated check can't be run
copy.isolated.noSupervisor.note: cw-progress --isolated's refusal: Combwork can't run the check in a job of its own (#1435).

copy.isolated.notLeased.text: no check copy could be leased: {error}
copy.isolated.notLeased.note: cw-progress --isolated's refusal: leasing its check copy failed. {error} is why.

copy.isolated.setupFailed.text: {copy}'s setup failed ({error}), so nothing was run
copy.isolated.setupFailed.note: cw-progress --isolated's refusal: its check copy's setup failed.

copy.isolated.stillInUse.text: a check copy ({copy} is still in use by {by})
copy.isolated.stillInUse.note: What cw-progress --isolated waits for: a check copy, the one it would get still held. {by} says by what.

copy.isolated.waitCopy.note: What cw-progress --isolated waits for ("waiting for a check copy"): none is free yet.

copy.isolated.waitSetup.text: a check copy to be set up
copy.isolated.waitSetup.note: What cw-progress --isolated waits for: its check copy is being set up.

copy.refusal.noCopy.text: no check copy free: the pool's {size} {count, plural, =1 {copy is} other {copies are}} in use
copy.refusal.noCopy.note: Why no check or review copy was lent (#1435): every copy is in use. {size} is the pool's size as digits; {count} the same number, choosing the plural.

copy.refusal.off.text: review copies are off (Settings → Advanced, Reviewers review in review copies)
copy.refusal.off.note: Why a reviewer gets no review copy: the advanced setting is off. Names the setting as the window shows it.

copy.refusal.returned.text: its lease of {copy} was returned while the copy was being set up
copy.refusal.returned.note: Why a copy was not lent: the lease was given back during its setup.

copy.refusal.setupFailed.note: Why a copy was not lent: its setup failed. {error} is why (copy.error.*, git's or the command's).

copy.refusal.stillInUse.note: Why a copy was not lent: the copy is still held. {by} says by what (copy.held.*, a run, an agent).

copy.review.ended.note: Why a reviewer gets no review copy: its review ended while the copy was set up. The end of copy.review.none.

copy.review.leaseFailed.note: Why a reviewer gets no review copy: leasing it failed. The end of copy.review.none.

copy.review.noRevision.text: the card has no submitted revision
copy.review.noRevision.note: Why a reviewer gets no review copy: nothing was submitted to review. The end of copy.review.none.

copy.review.none.text: No review copy ({why}): review the builder's work read-only from where you are.
copy.review.none.note: Start review's reply, or a later message, when the reviewer gets no review copy. {why} is why.

copy.review.notGoing.note: Why a reviewer gets no review copy: its review of the card has ended or not started. The end of copy.review.none.

copy.review.ready.text: {named, select, yes {{card}'s review copy is ready. } other {}}Review in {folder} at {revision}: read and run commands there. Your session and its shell stay in your own folder, so change into the copy in each command.
copy.review.ready.note: A reviewer's review copy (#1435): in start review's reply, or its later message (which names the card first). {revision} is the submission's first 12 characters.

copy.review.settingUp.note: Why a reviewer waits for a review copy: its copy is being set up. The end of copy.review.waiting.

copy.review.stalled.text: {card}'s review by {agent} has waited {minutes} min for a review copy: {why}.
copy.review.stalled.note: Why a card in Review is stalled (HI-1764), in a lane watch and the Agent API's stalled: its reviewer is kept from reviewing. {minutes} is whole minutes.

copy.review.waiting.text: Waiting for a review copy ({why}): Combwork tells you when one is ready, with its folder. Meanwhile git can show the submission from where you are.
copy.review.waiting.note: Start review's reply while no review copy is free yet. {why} is why (copy.inUse.*, copy.refusal.*).

copy.review.workflowOff.text: workflow rules aren't enforced (Settings → Advanced, Workflow rules are enforced)
copy.review.workflowOff.note: Why a reviewer gets no review copy: the advanced setting is off. Names the setting as the window shows it.
